title: Pi exact Code-Kit runtime identity API compatibility

argv: from pathlib import Path; p=Path(r'tests/test_runtime_identity_kit_contract.py'); assert p.exists() and p.stat().st_size>0; print('PI_RUNTIME_KIT_ARTIFACT_OK')

import inspect; from sentinelmesh.runtime import InvocationSpec, ProcessIdentity, Lifecycle, classify_start, reconcile, validate_argv; assert list(inspect.signature(validate_argv).parameters)==['command','shell']; assert list(inspect.signature(classify_start).parameters)==['handoff_accepted','started_observation','expected']; assert list(inspect.signature(reconcile).parameters)==['expected','observed']; ProcessIdentity(1,'boot','a'*64,'wt'); print('PI_RUNTIME_KIT_API_OK')

definition_of_done.text: 严格兼容 Code-Kit runtime 的公共构造器和签名：validate_argv(command, *, shell=False)、InvocationSpec 四元字段与立即校验/digest、ProcessIdentity(pid/boot_id/executable_sha256/worktree_id)、Lifecycle NEW/0/transition(expected_generation)。
classify_start(handoff_accepted, started_observation, expected) 与 reconcile(expected, observed) 的参数顺序、返回键和保守语义对齐；START_UNKNOWN 允许在 generation fence 下对账为 STARTED/STOPPING/FAILED，不能盲重发。
generation 每次有效 transition 递增，stale expected_generation、identity mismatch、shell/NUL/C1/surrogate/坏 SHA 在构造或调用入口 fail closed；旧 Invocation/ProcessResult/SubprocessRunner API 不回归。
新测试直接调用 Code-Kit 参考形状，覆盖 immediate constructor validation、digest、START_UNKNOWN recovery、stale transition、identity mismatch、reconcile replay gate 和非法 argv。
无依赖、无凭据/联网/真实 provider；跨平台 native cleanup 仍明确 NOT_RUN/BLOCKED。
